name: rohy-vi
description: Checks and formats rohy correlation rule files with rohyctl — the check the application loads them with — and with the rule schema when rohyctl is not installed.

virtualWorkspaces.description: rohyctl checks files on this machine.

rohy.rohyctlPath.markdownDescription: The absolute path of a `rohyctl` to check rule files with, instead of the one packaged with the extension. Empty means the packaged one, or, where there is none, the first `rohyctl` on `PATH`. Read from user settings only, so an opened folder cannot choose the program that is run over its files.

rohy.ruleFiles.markdownDescription: More glob patterns for rule files, beyond the application's rules folder (`rohy-data/rules`) and its built-in library. A pattern with no root matches anywhere: `rules/*.json` is any `rules` folder. Files matched only here are checked and formatted by `rohyctl`; the schema's hover and completion cover only the default folders.
